description: This file is the minified/concatenated source code for Leaflet version 1.0.0-beta.2, a JavaScript library used for creating interactive maps. It defines core components such as utilities, coordinate systems, CRS (Coordinate Reference Systems), map handling, layers, tile layers, overlays, and various map controls.

classes.name: o.Map
classes.description: Represents the main map object, handling view, zoom, layers, events, and user interactions.

classes.name: o.Layer
classes.description: Base class for all map layers, including tile layers, overlays, and controls.

classes.name: o.GridLayer
classes.description: Base class for grid-based layers such as tile layers.

classes.name: o.TileLayer
classes.description: Represents a tile layer that loads and displays map tiles from a URL template.

classes.name: o.ImageOverlay
classes.description: Displays a georeferenced image over a specific geographical bounds.

classes.name: o.Icon
classes.description: Represents default icons for markers.

classes.name: o.Icon
classes.description: Represents default icons for markers, including methods to create icon and shadow elements, and to set styles.

classes.name: o.Marker
classes.description: Defines map marker objects capable of being positioned, customized with icons, and responding to map events.

classes.name: o.Popup
classes.description: Represents popup overlays that can be attached to map layers or markers, with methods to show, hide, and update content.

classes.name: o.LayerGroup
classes.description: A collection of layers that can be managed as a single entity.

classes.name: o.FeatureGroup
classes.description: A subclass of LayerGroup with additional features like styling and event handling.

classes.name: o.Renderer
classes.description: Base class for rendering vector shapes using SVG, Canvas, or VML.

classes.name: o.Path
classes.description: Base class for vector shape objects such as polylines, polygons, circles, responsible for rendering and interaction.

classes.name: o.Polyline
classes.description: Represents a series of connected line segments with methods for path manipulation and spatial queries.

classes.name: o.Polygon
classes.description: Represents a filled shape with multiple parts, subclass of Polyline.

classes.name: o.Rectangle
classes.description: A polygon with bounds defined by southwest and northeast corners.

classes.name: o.CircleMarker
classes.description: Represents a circle shaped marker with radius, capable of hit-testing and styling.

classes.name: o.Circle
classes.description: A circular shape with radius, extending CircleMarker.

classes.name: o.SVG
classes.description: Renderer class for SVG vector graphics, with methods to create and update SVG paths and shapes.

classes.name: o.Canvas
classes.description: Renderer class for HTML5 Canvas, capable of drawing vector shapes and handling animations.

classes.name: o.GeoJSON
classes.description: Layer class for rendering GeoJSON data, converting GeoJSON objects into corresponding vector layers.

methods.name: createIcon
methods.description: Creates the DOM element for a marker icon or shadow.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Sets the geographical center and zoom level of the map.

methods.name: addLayer
methods.description: Adds a layer to the map.

methods.name: removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a layer from the map.

methods.name: fitBounds
methods.description: Adjusts the map view to contain the given geographical bounds.

methods.name: getZoom
methods.description: Returns the current zoom level of the map.

methods.name: o.Icon.createIcon
methods.description: Creates DOM element for a marker icon or shadow, applying styles and setting source URLs.

methods.name: o.Marker._initIcon
methods.description: Initializes marker icon and shadow DOM elements, applying classes and styles, and adding to pane.

methods.name: o.Popup._initLayout
methods.description: Constructs the HTML structure for popup, including layout, close button, and arrow tip.

methods.name: o.Path.setStyle
methods.description: Sets CSS styles for vector shapes, including stroke, fill, opacity, and line properties.

methods.name: o.Polyline._convertLatLngs
methods.description: Converts nested arrays or single array of lat-lngs into internal coordinate representation.

methods.name: o.Polyline._project
methods.description: Calculates pixel positions of points based on current zoom and view settings.

methods.name: o.Polyline._updatePath
methods.description: Calls renderer to generate the SVG/CANVAS path data for the polyline.

search-terms: Icon class and default icon options
Event handling and DOM event management
Path style and path update methods
Pointer and touch event handling mechanisms
Map interactions: panning, zooming, box zoom
Event handling in touch and pointer contexts
Map movement and zoom animation implementation
Custom control creation and positioning within map container
